what: N work photo plates (3.2×2, corners rounded .03, up to 14) stand on a ring of radius 8.2, all facing the center, and slowly turn .0016rad per frame (three.js, fov 42, camera 12.8, on phones 768px and under fov 52, camera 16). The ring sits offset 2.6 to the right of the screen and follows the cursor by .05 per frame, ±.25 sideways and ±.06rad tilt. Plates lie dark (.66) in black and white, and only the front one scales 1.14x, goes to brightness 1 and gets half (.5) of its color back. A hovered plate grows to 1.22x, ripples (sin(24d−3t)), pushes and splits RGB around the cursor, and its color fully returns (each value eases .1 to .15 per frame). Dragging turns .006rad per 1px, and on release the speed returns to default by .02 per frame, and the faster it spins the more the plates split into RGB (glitch). When the front plate changes, the name line slides up over .5s and returns with the new name after .26s. Releasing after moving under 5px opens that plate’s link.

options.x: Distance the ring shifts right, default 2.6
options.x-phone: Distance to move aside on phone, default 0
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Panel One = A single link (goes to href). data-label is the photo-slot label, data-client and data-title are the text of the name line
options.[data-fx-part=meta] · client · title · n: If present, fills in the front page name, number (01) and total (/14)
options.fx:front: Event the element emits when the front section changes (detail.index)

note: Photo spots are drawn as two color bands with the hue rotated 47° each from the accent color + a label (so the grayscale → color reveal is visible). As in the original, textures are read as sRGB with no output conversion, so the panel is slightly dark. The last position is remembered even when the cursor leaves the panel (as in the original).
